codeReview.summary: The feature adds a working harness, validator, and tests, but it does not enforce the required four-comparator matrix for every scenario; missing comparator cells are treated as skips, so VAL-BENCH-001 can pass while matrix coverage is incomplete.

issues.description: Missing comparator commands are silently marked as skipped (`No command template for <comp>`) instead of failing the run. This allows incomplete scenario-comparator cells to pass. Evidence: `manifests/scenarios.json` contains scenarios with only `ag`/`rust-ag` commands (e.g. `edge-ignore-scope-leak` at lines 200-207 and `cli-context-symmetric` at lines 371-378 in the reviewed commit), so full-matrix execution across `ag`/`rust-ag`/`rg`/`ugrep` is not actually enforced.

Missing-cell validation only iterates comparators present in each scenario's `commands` map and never checks required comparators from the canonical set. As a result, runs with absent `rg`/`ugrep` cells for a scenario can still pass `no missing scenario-comparator cells`, violating VAL-BENCH-001 semantics.

Matrix-completeness tests intentionally accept partial scenarios and only assert that at least one scenario has all four comparators. This weakens regression protection for VAL-BENCH-001 and did not catch incomplete per-scenario comparator coverage.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared state says comparator set is fixed to all four tools, but mission artifacts do not document when partial scenario comparator sets are acceptable, leading to conflicting interpretations of VAL-BENCH-001.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/benchmarking.md states comparator set is fixed to Rust rewrite + ag + rg + ugrep, while `manifests/scenarios.json` in the reviewed commit includes scenarios with only ag/rust-ag command entries (e.g., lines 200-207 and 371-378).

summary: Review failed: comparator-matrix completeness is not strictly enforced in execution or validation, and current tests permit partial comparator coverage per scenario despite VAL-BENCH-001 requiring complete scenario-comparator cells.
